answer: Don't let clones hide in the crowd. Each epoch, VRF picks 5% of identities at random, and you must show proof of work within 2 epochs. Miss once and your rewards freeze for 6 epochs. Miss twice and you lose 50% of your stake. Seven jurors check each proof, so you can't fake it. A mesa of clones can't dodge the draw, and a juniper flag marks each miss. 1,000 clones lock 120,000 units, with 50 picked each round. Honest agents just show up. The anchor is simple: random checks beat big farms.
